name: PhD in Bioscience and Biotechnology, Interdisciplinary
detailsNote: Official information is available. Admissions are rolling without set deadlines; an admission model was not established from these pages.

publishedDeadlines.label: Graduate admissions
publishedDeadlines.note: Central admissions states no set deadlines; confirm program funding availability.

english.note: PTE 56 also accepted. English-medium instruction alone and university certificates do not waive testing. A degree from a listed country where English is the native language can qualify for exemption.

applicationFee.note: Central admissions currently waives graduate application fees; no end date or nationality restriction stated. Confirm continued availability.

documents: Statement of purpose naming two or three prospective faculty advisors
requirements.note: Four-year bachelor in biology or relevant science. Prerequisites: three biology semesters including genetics; four chemistry including organic; two physics; two mathematics including calculus. Central personal-statement guidance is 250–500 words.

funding.note: All graduate students are considered for merit assistance, awarded by departments; an award is not guaranteed. Teaching and research assistantships provide stipend plus full tuition, but not every assistantship type is available in every program.

sources.label: Central rolling admissions, fee and documents
